source_text: Mulieres sapientes nerebant; principes obtulerunt lapides. Utriusque sexus ministeria in tabernaculo. Nullus otiosus in ecclesia.
pass_a_gloss: Women wise were-spinning; princes offered stones. Of-both sex ministries in tabernacle. No-one idle in church.
pass_b_english: [[Wise women spun; the leaders offered stones >> Bible:Exodus 35:25-27]]. Both sexes minister in the tabernacle. No one is idle in the church.
